_comment: Measured shape of a real multi-agent run, used to calibrate the synthetic
fixture in fixture.go. NUMBERS ONLY: no source-run document text, carrier
content, or prompt file is reproduced here or anywhere in this repository.
The synthetic fixture reproduces these proportions with generated filler
text. See plan revision 5 (P7) on the blackboard for why the real corpus is
not vendored, and revision 5 S1 for why carrier internal structure is
calibrated and not only carrier size.
DRIFT: these figures are a single-run snapshot. Re-measure with
against a live run to detect divergence.

source.note: external repository, not vendored; path supplied by the operator at measurement time

carrier_block.measurement_note: LC_ALL=C byte count; an earlier character count read 67942249 and was a slight under-estimate

carriers.note: occurrences exceed distinct because the same carrier at the same blob OID is inlined into many prompts; this is what produces the high cache-read rate

carrier_structure._comment: S1: section-scoped inclusion is only measurable if fixture carriers have sections to scope to

duplicate_direct_references._comment: DIRECT REFERENCE blocks whose span is a verbatim substring of a CARRIER inlined in full at the same path in the same prompt. Verified by byte containment, not path match alone.
duplicate_direct_references.note: the not-contained blocks are pinned at a different blob than the inlined carrier and must never be elided; corpus total for this pass was 81352099 bytes under utf-8 replacement decoding

ancestor_carrier_references._comment: DIRECT REFERENCE blocks declared by inherited scalar carriers (the epic behind an architecture plan, the architecture plan behind a code plan) rather than by the assigned carrier. Measured 2026-09-17 on the same run after it grew to 558 prompts / 136133968 bytes. Classification is textual: within one prompt, carriers at the majority revision are taken as scalar (loaded at integration HEAD), the others as parent/review carriers; the most specific scalar by path kind (plan > arch-plan > epic > other) is counted as assigned unless a parent/review carrier of equal or higher kind is present. Prompts whose carriers all share one revision (64) cannot be classified this way and are excluded.
ancestor_carrier_references.note: an estimate, not the rule's exact effect: path-kind inference stands in for the task's scalar ref fields, which the rendered text does not carry

depends_on_sites._comment: Four real render sites. Zeros are recorded as zeros deliberately: absence in this run is a finding, not a reason to omit the row.

site2_descendant_dependencies.note: slice-integration section absent from this run; uncapped and O(descendants x deps) when present

site3_sibling_consistency_rule.note: uncapped; role-pair filtered, so a fixture without same-role-pair phase deps silently measures zero

site4_active_task_digest.note: task count capped at 12, dependency count uncapped; this is where per-subtask inherited fan-out lands

site5_task_graph_digest.note: bounded by construction; not separately measured

RoleContext.DependsOn.note: flagged for deletion in commit 3; branch_integration_context.tmpl:22 reads IntegrationDescendantSummary.DependsOn, a different field
